card.$description: Grouped settings cards and the custom-instructions field. Diagonal-inset reading: 25.6pt dark, 25.6pt light. Plus or minus 2 pt.

composer.$description: The composer's corners: 22.2pt. The composer grows to two rows, so it is a rounded rectangle, not a capsule.

bubble.$description: The owner's message bubble: 22.2pt, all four corners alike (no tail).

menuLarge.$description: The plus menu, which rises from the composer's corner: 44.4pt. The glass rim softens the edge, so this reads high; plus or minus 4 pt.

tile.$description: The 40 pt tile behind the empty-state magnifier: too small for the diagonal reading, judged against the tile's size.

capsule.$description: Fully round ends: the Chat / Work control and its thumb, tab pills, the Chat, New task and New chat pills, alert buttons, the search field, switches, the usage meter and the effort slider.

base.$description: Measured gaps land on multiples of 4 pt within a pixel or two.

xs.$description: Gap between a section header and its card's top rim region, and inside pills.

sm.$description: Gap between the composer's two rows and between the slider's steps and its rim.

md.$description: The composer's side margin: it starts 12 pt from the screen edge.

lg.$description: Screen margin: settings cards start 16 pt from the screen edge, reply text 17 pt, the owner's bubble ends 16.5 pt from the right.

xl.$description: Text inset of section headers and helper text from the screen margin: they start 36 pt from the screen edge, 20 pt inside the cards' edge.

xxl.$description: Gap between the end of a reply and its action row, and between stacked task cards (24 pt in 21-scheduled-tabs-cards-primary-pill).

screenMargin.$description: Left and right margin of cards, reply text and the owner's bubble.

row.$description: Single-line grouped row in Settings, divider to divider.

navButton.$description: Round glass buttons: sidebar, close, back, new chat (a circle). The reading includes the glass rim's soft edge.

width.$description: The Chat / Work control at the top of a new chat.

thumb.$description: The selected thumb: 75x49pt, half the control.

width.$description: The composer, full width less the side margins.

height.$description: The composer with an empty field: the text row above, the tool row (+, model pill, microphone, send) below.

sendButton.$description: Send and voice buttons, a circle: 31.5x32pt dark, 31.5x31.5pt light.

inkButton.$description: The ink pill on an empty state (New chat): 99x40pt.

tab.$description: Tab pills (Active, Paused; search's All), height. 'Active' is 74.5pt wide.

menuIcon.$description: Round icon well beside each plus-menu item.

button.$description: Alert button height (139.5x47.5pt, two side by side).

searchBar.$description: Search field height (293pt wide beside a round close button).

height.$description: Effort slider: a glass capsule holding six steps.

thumb.$description: Effort slider thumb, a white circle (39.5x40pt).

bubbleMaxWidth.$description: The widest owner's bubble (269x276pt), right-aligned. Replies have no bubble and run the full text width.

caret.$description: Text caret height: 46 px (light 02, one column scan), 2 px wide.

touchTarget.$description: The round glass buttons, rows and the alert buttons are 44 pt or more. The send button (32 pt) sits inside the composer.

hairline.$description: Dividers between grouped rows: one device pixel at 2x (border.divider reads a one-pixel row).

dashed.$description: The dashed rim of a recommended task card, about two device pixels.

base.$description: Not determinable from pixels. The letterforms match the iOS system face (SF Pro); use the platform font.

math.$description: Rendered maths in replies uses a serif italic close to KaTeX's; not determinable from pixels.

regular.$description: Reply text, rows, menu items, suggestions, helper text. Judged by stroke width, not measured.

medium.$description: Segment and tab labels, pill labels. Judged by stroke width.

semibold.$description: Nav titles, section headers, the alert title, bold reply text. Judged by stroke width.

bold.$description: The sidebar's ChatGPT title. Judged by stroke width.

titleLarge.$description: The sidebar's ChatGPT title. Cap-height readings: 22pt.

menuLarge.$description: Plus-menu items (Camera, Photos, Files), larger than other menus. Cap-height readings: 20pt.

headline.$description: Nav titles, section headers, the alert title, bold lines in replies. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

body.$description: Reply text, settings rows, sidebar items and recents, menu items, the composer, suggestions, tab labels, task-card titles, pill and alert-button labels. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

bubble.$description: Text in the owner's bubble: body size on a looser line. Cap-height readings: 17pt.

callout.$description: Chat / Work labels and empty-state body text. Cap-height readings: 15pt.

footnote.$description: Helper text under cards, task-card descriptions (on an 18 pt line), the thread date line, the usage reset time. Cap-height readings: 12pt.

notTokenised: iOS 26 glass (round buttons, the Chat / Work control, the composer, menus, the alert, the search field, the slider): blur and refraction come from the system material
Continuous (squircle) corners: DTCG has no value for corner smoothing
Shadows: the light theme's glass casts a soft shadow that was not measured; dark draws none
Line heights of titles and one-line labels: only multi-line blocks were measured
Dash pattern of a task card's rim: 7 pt dashes on a 16 pt period (DTCG strokeStyle has no dash length)
Sidebar and suggestion row pitch: 48 pt and 47 pt (lines.sidebar, lines.suggestions); rows have no dividers

page.$description: New chat, threads, the sidebar, search and Scheduled.

grouped.$description: Settings pages behind the grouped cards: black in dark, iOS's grouped grey in light.

scrim.$description: Black at 20%: the custom-instructions field reads #FFFFFF undimmed and #CCCCCC under the alert.

card.$description: Grouped cards and the custom-instructions field.

composer.$description: The composer (glass), centre reading. In light the material is a soft white gradient. The box's dominant colour covers 32% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

glass.$description: Round glass buttons (sidebar, close, back, new chat), read beside the glyph. Translucent: tints with what is behind. The box's dominant colour covers 27% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

segmentThumb.$description: The selected half of the Chat / Work control: darker than the track in dark, a grey in light.

tabSelected.$description: The selected tab pill (Active, Paused, search's All).

menu.$description: Menus over the page (plus menu, accent colour pop-up).

userBubble.$description: The owner's message bubble, set by the Blue accent: a deep navy in dark, a pale blue in light.

dialog.$description: Alert card (glass over the scrim). The box's dominant colour covers 69% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

dialogButton.$description: Buttons inside an alert (Cancel, Retry): a lighter glass capsule. The box's dominant colour covers 42% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

taskCard.$description: A recommended task card on Scheduled: white, close to the page, so the dashed rim carries it.

searchTile.$description: The tile behind the empty-state magnifier.

searchField.$description: Search field at the bottom of search (glass). Not captured in light: filled from surface.composer, the same glass.

progressTrack.$description: Usage meter track: the meter's blue at low opacity.

sliderTrack.$description: Effort slider track (glass). The box's dominant colour covers 18% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

banner.$description: The 'Share Message' banner that slid over the top of a thread. The box's dominant colour covers 30% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

divider.$description: Hairline between grouped rows, inset to the row label.

sidebar.$description: Rule between the sidebar's nav items and its recents.

dashed.$description: The dashed rim of a recommended task card: 7 pt dashes on a 16 pt period. The box's dominant colour covers 64% of it (a gradient, glass or a thin mark), so it is a reading, not an exact fill.

reply.$description: Assistant reply text, which sits on the page with no bubble.
